project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used. The `answer_choices` block supports: * `bool_value` - (Optional) Boolean value. * `key` - (Optional) A short string used as an identifier. * `na_value` - (Optional) A value of "Not Applicable (N/A)". If provided, this field may only be set to `true`. If a question receives this answer, it will be excluded from any score calculations. * `num_value` - (Optional) Numerical value. * `score` - (Optional) Numerical score of the answer, used for generating the overall score of a QaScorecardResult. If the answer uses na_value, this field is unused. * `str_value` - (Optional) String value. The `metrics` block supports: * `accuracy` - (Output) Accuracy of the model. Measures the percentage of correct answers the model gave on the test set. The `predefined_question_config` block supports: * `type` - (Optional) The type of the predefined question. Possible values: CONVERSATION_OUTCOME CONVERSATION_OUTCOME_ESCALATION_INITIATOR_ROLE The `qa_question_data_options` block supports: * `conversation_data_options` - (Optional) Options for configuring what metadata is included in the conversation data used in QAI and Discovery Engine. Structure is [documented below](#nested_qa_question_data_options_conversation_data_options). The `conversation_data_options` block supports: * `include_dialogflow_interaction_data` - (Optional) Whether to include the per turn Dialogflow interaction data in conversation transcript. The `tuning_metadata` block supports: * `dataset_validation_warnings` - (Optional) A list of any applicable data validation warnings about the question's feedback labels. * `total_valid_label_count` - (Optional) Total number of valid labels provided for the question at the time of tuining. * `tuning_error` - (Optional) Error status of the tuning operation for the question. Will only be set if the tuning operation failed.
